# Jack Jin

> Personal website of Jack Jin, an Associate Director at Accenture in Columbus, Ohio. His work covers AI engineering, cloud architecture, Adobe Experience Manager, and Edge Delivery Services.

The pages below contain readable HTML, with original project diagrams and source links. Portfolio metrics describe historical project snapshots; they are not live repository totals. Technical Writing is being migrated and currently contains no published articles. Personal views and projects should not be attributed to Accenture.

## Main pages

- [Jack Jin](https://www.jackzhaojin.com/): Introduction and selected work.
- [Portfolio](https://www.jackzhaojin.com/portfolio/): AI systems, content platforms, project histories, diagrams, and source repositories. Individual projects have stable chapter anchors.
- [Talks](https://www.jackzhaojin.com/talks/): Conference sessions, community demos, and guest lectures with supporting event or project links.
- [Certifications](https://www.jackzhaojin.com/certifications/): Credential records and direct verification links. Consult the issuer record for current status.
- [Technical Writing](https://www.jackzhaojin.com/writing/): Migration notice for forthcoming on-site articles and rewritten video companions.

## Discovery

- [Sitemap](https://www.jackzhaojin.com/sitemap.xml): Canonical indexable pages.

The design-systems directory contains development references and historical demonstrations, not the current public content archive.
